sections.title: Do the thinking first
body: The best results come from deciding more before the assistant writes anything.
points: Write the requirements down and read them properly
Define how the result will be verified, before building
Agree the design: patterns, principles, architecture
Work in phases, each with a check
Encode conventions as rules, not reminders
sections.caption: Five habit cards pass through checks along a track.

sections.title: Less room to guess
body: Every unanswered question is a place the assistant will improvise. Clear requirements and a verification definition turn improvisation into execution.
sections.caption: A vague ask leaves gaps the assistant fills with guesses.

sections.title: Habits you can see
body: Sensei scores how deep a session’s opening plan was, flags when work departs from it, and turns what you keep correcting into rules the assistant receives next time.
sections.caption: Sensei scores the plan and turns corrections into rules.

sections.title: The full cycle
body: Our article “Working with AI without the overload” walks through the whole cycle step by step.
sections.caption: Work passes five gates along its path.

takeawaySub: Sensei helps with all five habits.
